lines.trans: Wait, Vitya, hear me out to the end.
A Michelin inspector has secretly arrived in Moscow.
Where do you think he will go first?
He will go straight to the very best restaurant.
Your restaurant without me is no longer the best.
You will have a chance to get a Michelin star!
Dima, I have very little time right now.
Look what kind of car they gave me recently.
If you agree, this ride will be yours!
Fresh trout was just delivered, I am going to receive it.
Vitya, think carefully about the Michelin star.
And do not forget about this car either.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'and', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Димочка, ну не расстраивайся ты так.
examples.trans: Dimochka, well do not get so upset.

examples.text: У меня сейчас сплошные нервы и стресс.
examples.trans: I have nothing but nerves and stress right now.

examples.text: Я новый контракт не могу подписать.
examples.trans: I cannot sign a new contract.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'also', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: И про эту машину тоже не забывай.
examples.trans: And do not forget about this car either.

examples.text: Я тоже приготовил блюдо дня из отходов.
examples.trans: I also prepared a dish of the day out of scraps.

examples.text: Я тоже.
examples.trans: Me too.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'бывать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to forget', paired with 'забыть'.

examples.text: И про эту машину тоже не забывай.
examples.trans: And do not forget about this car either.

examples.text: И про машину не забывай.
examples.trans: And do not forget about the car.

examples.text: Я всегда забываю ключи.
examples.trans: I always forget my keys.
